This is the same HF-06 pattern reviewer 17 finding 2 removed from AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, whose conclusion now explicitly says 'This is a definition, not an asserted equivalence with any other formulation (review HF-06)'. The repair was applied to one WCC class and not to the other.
